reviewer_note: For the proposals that were just proposed spans I was not sure what you wanted. For the ones re: which party you were missing the intro language so I did not know what the limb was attached to.
conclusions: The instrument works where the card is well formed: 4/4 detection and 0/16 false alarms on MATERIALITY_CODE.
The packet defect predicted in PLAN.md 2Y-0 amendment 0 is now MEASURED, not asserted: party-attribution detection collapses from 100% to 25% precisely where the excerpt carries no party.

SPAN is a distinct and worse failure: not a missing-context problem but a missing-question problem. 0 of 16 answered. The class has no stated criterion, so it cannot be scored at all in its current form.

Zero false alarms across 54 decisions materially weakens the concern that zero-tolerance criteria would fail every rung on adjudicator noise -- for a HUMAN adjudicator. It says nothing yet about AI adjudicators.
